main_text.p: Agages sive Jacchas[?], populus interioris Africæ ferocissimus, A.C. 1560 in regnum Congo irruperunt, illudque ingenti cæde exhaustum penitus destruxerunt. Ab eo tempore Congenses se nunquam recolligere potuere.
main_text.head: MONOMOTAPANA. Canon.
main_text.p: 4. Mono- mota- pana,Monomotapa dividitur in IV. regna.

Verum Monomotapæ nomen est Mocaranga, quæ olim uni Monarchæ suberat; sed superiori seculo imperator, cum se tot regnis gubernandis imparem videret, inter quatuor filios eadem distribuit, & majori natu dedit regnum Monomotapa, secundo regnum Quideva, tertio Sedanda, & quarto Chicanga.

page.notes: The left edge of the scan shows show-through and the neighbouring page edge; these are not transcribed. "Jacchas" is uncertain because the word is partly obscured by the ligature.
